card.capacity_status_quote: Clearly, our demand is outstripping our supply this year.
card.demand_direction_quote: Our demand is actually the best I have ever seen in my Arista tenure.
card.pricing_power_quote: While we did consider and have raised prices a little bit, unlike our competitors, we have not done two price increases.
card.guidance_direction_quote: As Jayshree mentioned, we are now pleased to raise our 2026 fiscal year outlook to 27.7% revenue growth, delivering approximately $11.5 billion.
card.constraint_owner_quote: We are experiencing industry-wide shortages across the board, be it wafers, silicon chips, CPUs, optics, and, of course, memory that I referred to last quarter, coupled with elevated cost to procure these.
